<script type="application/ecmascript"><![CDATA[

//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
// Grab the styling values from the R code and inject them into global variables
//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

var tooltipOptions = {
    fontColor:   "%FONT_COLOR%",
    fillColor:   "%FILL_COLOR%",
    borderColor: "%BORDER_COLOR%",
    fillOpacity:  %FILL_OPACITY%,
    borderWidth:  %BORDER_WIDTH%,
    fontFamily:  "%FONT_FAMILY%",
    fontSize:     %FONT_SIZE%,
    paddingX:     %PADDING_X%,
    paddingY:     %PADDING_Y%,
    cornerRadius: %CORNER_RADIUS%,
    groupColor:  "%GROUP_COLOR%"
};

//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
// Set up the function that makes the toolstip pop up
//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

function showTooltip(evt, text){
    // Dom element selection
    var svg     = evt.target.ownerSVGElement;
    var tooltip = document.getElementById("tooltip");
    var label   = document.getElementById("tooltip-text");
    var bg      = document.getElementById("tooltip-bg");

    // Extract {bg:COLOR} marker if present (compare tooltips). The marker is
    // stripped from the display text and used as the tooltip background color.
    var bgColor = null;
    var bgMatch = text.match(/^\{bg:([^}]+)\}/);
    if (bgMatch){
        bgColor = bgMatch[1];
        text = text.substring(bgMatch[0].length);
    }

    // Map coordinates according to the canvas itself
    var cursor;
    var pt = svg.createSVGPoint();

    pt.x = evt.clientX;
    pt.y = evt.clientY;

    cursor = pt.matrixTransform(svg.getScreenCTM().inverse());

    // Font must be scaled according to the current displayed size of the graphic.
    // The zoom has to be countered basically.
    var scaleFactor     = svg.viewBox.baseVal.width / svg.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    var adaptedFontSize = parseFloat(tooltipOptions.fontSize) * scaleFactor;
    var adaptedPaddingX = parseFloat(tooltipOptions.paddingX) * scaleFactor;
    var adaptedPaddingY = parseFloat(tooltipOptions.paddingY) * scaleFactor;

    // Set up font
    label.setAttribute("font-family", tooltipOptions.fontFamily);
    label.setAttribute("font-size", adaptedFontSize + "px");

    // Clear previous multi line text element
    while(label.firstChild) { label.removeChild(label.firstChild); }

    // Put together and format multi line tooltips
    var lines = text.split("!!!");

    for(var lineIndex = 0; lineIndex < lines.length; lineIndex++){
        var line = lines[lineIndex];

        // Extract legend color if present
        var legendColor = null;
        var legendMatch = line.match(/\{legend:([^}]+)\}/);

        if(legendMatch){
            legendColor = legendMatch[1];

            line = line.replace(/\{legend:[^}]+\}/, "{sq}");
        }

        var bold = false;
        var xPos = adaptedPaddingX;

        // Current line is cut up into pieces which determine whether parts of
        // the text are drawn in bold or in normal font weight.
        var pieces = line.split(/(\{b\}|\{\/b\}|\{sq\})/);

        for(var pieceIndex = 0; pieceIndex < pieces.length; pieceIndex++){
            var piece = pieces[pieceIndex];

            // Set bold entry and exit points
            if(piece === "{b}")  { bold = true;  continue; }
            if(piece === "{/b}") { bold = false; continue; }
            if(piece === "")     {               continue; }

            // Create and append inline sub-text tag (tspan)
            var tspan = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "tspan");

            // Replace the square placeholder and fill it with the corresponding legend color
            if(piece === "{sq}"){
                tspan.textContent = "■\u00A0";
                tspan.setAttribute("fill", legendColor);
                tspan.style.fill = legendColor; // Doppelte Absicherung für SVG-Rendering

                // Hier machen wir das Quadrat um ca. 30% größer als die normale Schrift
                tspan.setAttribute("font-size", (adaptedFontSize * 1.3) + "px");
                tspan.setAttribute("font-weight", "normal");
            }
            // Use normal style on standard text
            else{
                tspan.textContent = piece;
                tspan.setAttribute("font-weight", bold ? "bold" : "normal");
                // Falls das Tooltip standardmäßig eine Textfarbe hat (z. B. weiß oder schwarz), hier erzwingen:
                tspan.setAttribute("fill", window.getComputedStyle(label).fill || "black");
            }

            tspan.setAttribute("x", xPos);
            tspan.setAttribute("y", adaptedPaddingY + adaptedFontSize + (lineIndex * adaptedFontSize * 1.3));

            label.appendChild(tspan);

            // Advance cursor by the pixel width of rendered piece
            xPos += tspan.getComputedTextLength();
        }
    }

    // Calculate the tooltip box dimensions
    var bbox = label.getBBox();

    var tooltipWidth  = bbox.width + (2 * adaptedPaddingX);
    var tooltipHeight = bbox.height + (2 * adaptedPaddingY);

    //-------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Function which sets the text color dynamically to black or white depending
    // on the tooltip background color
    //-------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function getContrastColor(color){
        var rgb;

        if (color.charAt(0) === "#"){
            var hex = color.substring(1);

            if (hex.length === 3){
                rgb = [parseInt(hex[0]+hex[0],16), parseInt(hex[1]+hex[1],16), parseInt(hex[2]+hex[2],16)];
            }
            else{
                rgb = [parseInt(hex.substring(0,2),16), parseInt(hex.substring(2,4),16), parseInt(hex.substring(4,6),16)];
            }
        }
        else{
            rgb = color.match(/\d+/g);
        }

        if(!rgb || rgb.length < 3) { return "black"; }

        // Calculate YIQ relative luminance formula to dynamically check light vs. dark
        var brightness = (parseInt(rgb[0]) * 299 + parseInt(rgb[1]) * 587 + parseInt(rgb[2]) * 114) / 1000;
        return brightness > 128 ? "black" : "white";
    }

    //-------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Formatting tooltips
    //-------------------------------------------------------------------------

    var tooltipTextColor, tooltipFillColor, tooltipBorderColor;

    var isGroup = evt.target.id && evt.target.id.indexOf("tooltip_group") === 0;

    // On auto grab the color of the respective segment
    if(tooltipOptions.fillColor === "auto"){
        // Compare tooltip: use the explicit background color from {bg:COLOR}
        if (bgColor){
            tooltipFillColor = bgColor;
        }
        // Group tooltip: use configured group background color
        else if (isGroup){
            tooltipFillColor = "%GROUP_TOOLTIP_BG%";
        }
        // Segment tooltip: use the hovered segment fill
        else{
            tooltipFillColor = window.getComputedStyle(evt.target).fill;
        }
    }
    // Otherwise get the user defined color (group still uses its own)
    else{
        tooltipFillColor = isGroup ? "%GROUP_TOOLTIP_BG%" : tooltipOptions.fillColor;
    }

    // On auto dynamically set the color to black or white
    if(tooltipOptions.fontColor === "auto"){
        if (bgColor){
            tooltipTextColor = getContrastColor(tooltipFillColor);
        }
        else if (isGroup){
            tooltipTextColor = "%GROUP_TOOLTIP_FONT%";
        }
        else{
            tooltipTextColor = getContrastColor(tooltipFillColor);
        }
    }
    // Otherwise get the user defined color (group still uses its own)
    else{
        tooltipTextColor = isGroup ? "%GROUP_TOOLTIP_FONT%" : tooltipOptions.fontColor;
    }

    // On auto grab the color of the respective segment
    if(tooltipOptions.borderColor === "auto"){
        tooltipBorderColor = isGroup ? "%GROUP_TOOLTIP_BORDER%" : "#000000";
    }
    // Otherwise get the user defined color (group still uses its own)
    else{
        tooltipBorderColor = isGroup ? "%GROUP_TOOLTIP_BORDER%" : tooltipOptions.borderColor;
    }

    // Apply user defined style options
    bg.setAttribute("fill", tooltipFillColor);
    bg.setAttribute("fill-opacity", tooltipOptions.fillOpacity);
    bg.setAttribute("stroke", tooltipBorderColor);
    bg.setAttribute("stroke-width", parseFloat(tooltipOptions.borderWidth) * scaleFactor);
    bg.setAttribute("rx", parseFloat(tooltipOptions.cornerRadius) * scaleFactor);
    bg.setAttribute("ry", parseFloat(tooltipOptions.cornerRadius) * scaleFactor);
    label.setAttribute("fill", tooltipTextColor);

    // Align background
    bg.setAttribute("x", bbox.x - adaptedPaddingX);
    bg.setAttribute("y", bbox.y - adaptedPaddingY);
    bg.setAttribute("width", tooltipWidth);
    bg.setAttribute("height", tooltipHeight);

    //-------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Tooltips are to be drawn inside the graphic. Which means, they are right
    // or left adjusted depending on which side of the graphic the tooltip pops
    // up. Same with top or bottom part, while this isnt as relevant.
    //-------------------------------------------------------------------------

    var svgWidth  = svg.viewBox.baseVal.width;
    var svgHeight = svg.viewBox.baseVal.height;

    // Evaluate layout space position quadrant rules
    var leftHalf   = cursor.x < svgWidth  / 2;
    var bottomPart = cursor.y < svgHeight / 4;
    var offset     = 10 * scaleFactor;

    // Compute Flip Horizontal Axis Boundary Collision
    var tooltipX = leftHalf ? (cursor.x + offset + 20) : (cursor.x - tooltipWidth - 10 - offset);

    // Compute Flip Vertical Axis Boundary Collision
    var tooltipY = bottomPart ? (cursor.y) : (cursor.y - tooltipHeight * 0.75 - offset);

    // Transform coordinate group placement matrix and release display
    tooltip.setAttribute("transform", "translate(" + tooltipX + "," + tooltipY + ")");
    tooltip.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
}

//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
// Hide tooltip
//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

function hideTooltip(){
    document.getElementById("tooltip").setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
}

//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
// Helpers
//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

function setOpacity(el, val){
    el.setAttribute("opacity", val);
    el.style.setProperty("opacity", val, "important");
}

// Applies setOpacity to every element in a NodeList.
function setOpacityForAll(nodeList, val){
    for (var i = 0; i < nodeList.length; i++){
        setOpacity(nodeList[i], val);
    }
}

// gridSVG disambiguates duplicate SVG element ids by appending ".1",
// ".2", ".3", etc. - and text grobs specifically get wrapped in their
// own sub-hierarchy for rendering: an outer ".scale" <g> (the y-flip),
// a ".text" <text>, and one or more ".tspan.N" <tspan> children. Since
// elements are matched by id PREFIX, all of those nested pieces get
// picked up too and each needs to resolve back to the same base id.
// Stripping suffixes one at a time, repeatedly, handles any mix of
// numeric duplicate suffixes and these named wrapper suffixes in
// whatever order/combination they appear.
function cleanId(id){
    var suffixPattern = /\.(scale|text|tspan\.\d+|\d+)$/;
    var clean = id;
    var match = clean.match(suffixPattern);

    while (match){
        clean = clean.slice(0, clean.length - match[0].length);
        match = clean.match(suffixPattern);
    }

    return clean;
}

function getSegType(id){
    var clean = cleanId(id);
    var match = clean.match(/_s(\d+)$/);
    return match ? parseInt(match[1], 10) : -1;
}

// Extract the numeric index from "segment_line_{N}" or "segment_labels_{N}"
function getLineIndex(id){
    var clean = cleanId(id);
    var match = clean.match(/(?:segment_line|segment_labels)_(\d+)$/);
    return match ? parseInt(match[1], 10) : -1;
}

// Every hover handler needs the same node lists - collected once here
// instead of each function independently re-querying the DOM.
function getChartElements(svg){
    return {
        groups:   svg.querySelectorAll("[id^='tooltip_group']"),
        segments: svg.querySelectorAll("[id^='tooltip_segment_']"),
        labels:   svg.querySelectorAll("[id^='segment_labels_']"),
        lines:    svg.querySelectorAll("[id^='segment_line_']"),
        syms:     svg.querySelectorAll("[id^='legend_symbol']"),
        ltxts:    svg.querySelectorAll("[id^='legend_labels']")
    };
}

//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
// Segment hover: ONLY the hovered segment + its legend entry + its label
// stay fully visible. Everything else receives a lowered opacity to make the
// main focused segment stand out.
//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

function dimOtherSegments(el){
    var svg      = el.ownerSVGElement;
    var elements = getChartElements(svg);

    var hoveredId = cleanId(el.id);
    var segType   = getSegType(el.id);

    for (var i = 0; i < elements.segments.length; i++){
        var isHovered = cleanId(elements.segments[i].id) === hoveredId;
        setOpacity(elements.segments[i], isHovered ? "1" : "%SEGMENT_HOVER_OPACITY%");
    }
    for (var i = 0; i < elements.labels.length; i++){
        var isMatch = cleanId(elements.labels[i].id) === "segment_labels_" + segType;
        setOpacity(elements.labels[i], isMatch ? "1" : "%SEGMENT_HOVER_OPACITY%");
    }
    for (var i = 0; i < elements.lines.length; i++){
        var isMatch = getLineIndex(elements.lines[i].id) === segType;
        setOpacity(elements.lines[i], isMatch ? "1" : "%SEGMENT_HOVER_OPACITY%");
    }
    for (var i = 0; i < elements.syms.length; i++){
        var isMatch = cleanId(elements.syms[i].id) === "legend_symbol" + segType;
        setOpacity(elements.syms[i], isMatch ? "1" : "%SEGMENT_HOVER_OPACITY%");
    }
    for (var i = 0; i < elements.ltxts.length; i++){
        var isMatch = cleanId(elements.ltxts[i].id) === "legend_labels" + segType;
        setOpacity(elements.ltxts[i], isMatch ? "1" : "%SEGMENT_HOVER_OPACITY%");
    }
}

//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
// Group hover: segments outside the group receive a lower opacity. Labels,
// legend, and lines stay visible.
//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

function dimOtherGroups(el, groupIndex){
    var svg      = el.ownerSVGElement;
    var elements = getChartElements(svg);

    var groupPrefix = "tooltip_segment_g" + groupIndex + "_";

    var hoveredId = cleanId(el.id);

    for (var i = 0; i < elements.groups.length; i++){
        var isHovered = cleanId(elements.groups[i].id) === hoveredId;
        setOpacity(elements.groups[i], isHovered ? "%GROUP_HOVER_OPACITY%" : "0");
    }
    for (var i = 0; i < elements.segments.length; i++){
        var inGroup = elements.segments[i].id.indexOf(groupPrefix) !== -1;
        setOpacity(elements.segments[i], inGroup ? "1" : "%SEGMENT_HOVER_OPACITY%");
    }

    setOpacityForAll(elements.labels, "1");
    setOpacityForAll(elements.lines, "1");
    setOpacityForAll(elements.syms, "1");
    setOpacityForAll(elements.ltxts, "1");
}

//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
// Type hover (legend entries and segment labels): every segment of the
// matching type + its legend entry + its label stay fully visible. Lines and
// other types receive a lower opacity.
//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

function dimOtherByType(el, typeIndex){
    var svg      = el.ownerSVGElement;
    var elements = getChartElements(svg);

    for (var i = 0; i < elements.segments.length; i++){
        var isMatch = getSegType(elements.segments[i].id) === typeIndex;
        setOpacity(elements.segments[i], isMatch ? "1" : "%SEGMENT_HOVER_OPACITY%");
    }
    for (var i = 0; i < elements.labels.length; i++){
        var isMatch = cleanId(elements.labels[i].id) === "segment_labels_" + typeIndex;
        setOpacity(elements.labels[i], isMatch ? "1" : "%SEGMENT_HOVER_OPACITY%");
    }
    for (var i = 0; i < elements.syms.length; i++){
        var isMatch = cleanId(elements.syms[i].id) === "legend_symbol" + typeIndex;
        setOpacity(elements.syms[i], isMatch ? "1" : "%SEGMENT_HOVER_OPACITY%");
    }
    for (var i = 0; i < elements.ltxts.length; i++){
        var isMatch = cleanId(elements.ltxts[i].id) === "legend_labels" + typeIndex;
        setOpacity(elements.ltxts[i], isMatch ? "1" : "%SEGMENT_HOVER_OPACITY%");
    }
    for (var i = 0; i < elements.lines.length; i++){
        var isMatch = getLineIndex(elements.lines[i].id) === typeIndex;
        setOpacity(elements.lines[i], isMatch ? "1" : "%SEGMENT_HOVER_OPACITY%");
    }
}


//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
// Reset everything
//+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

function resetAll(el){
    var svg      = el.ownerSVGElement;
    var elements = getChartElements(svg);

    setOpacityForAll(elements.segments, "1");
    setOpacityForAll(elements.labels, "1");
    setOpacityForAll(elements.lines, "1");
    setOpacityForAll(elements.syms, "1");
    setOpacityForAll(elements.ltxts, "1");
    setOpacityForAll(elements.groups, "0");
}

]]></script>
